answer: Each newcomer needs a co-signature from a sitting member the ledger draws at random, and each member may co-sign only two newcomers per 90 days. A farm wanting 400 identities must therefore keep 200 members who each passed a 40-hour graded review, so the scarce resource is reviewed seats rather than money. Any seat caught co-signing a duplicate forfeits its whole cohort, so a knoll of unvetted accounts gives the attacker no bridge to trusted standing and no timber to build on.
